edits.before: Q the pair — the tornado tick chips duos that stand in formation.
edits.after: Aqua Prison (Q) is a point-blank-to-ranged stun that sets up a big Ebb and Flow (W) trade, and her E buffs her ADC's autos — she out-trades your kit before you have E.

edits.before: W charge threat begins: the taunt governs their engage plans already.
edits.after: Her bubble threat still governs your positioning at rank 2, and the Q cooldown (12s at rank 1) is long enough that whiffing it is your only real punish window.

edits.before: Full kit: E-W the committed trade and the magic shield refunds their poke.
edits.after: Her poke and CC still out-range your gap-close at level 3, so play back and soak Aqua Prison (Q) on minions rather than forcing an engage.

edits.before: Zone with taunt threat and shield the margins — AP duos pay double rent.
edits.after: Your W Shield of Durand blocks her Ebb and Flow (W) poke and your Q slow lets Justice Punch (E) connect — the trade math flips to you.

edits.before: Hero's Entrance online — every roam your duo survives, you end.
edits.after: Hero's Entrance flashes onto her carry before Tidal Wave (R) — a slow, not a hard peel — can save them.

edits.before: First item: the taunt rotation chunks and the MR makes mage supports cry.
edits.after: Grievous Wounds timing cuts through Ebb and Flow (W) sustain, and your gap-close sticks through her shield-less kit once she can't kite far enough.

edits.before: Late Galio is the anti-dive: taunt their engage off your carry and R the map's emergencies.
edits.after: Tidal Wave (R) into Aqua Prison (Q) is a chain that can hard-lock your only engage, so bait the bubble first or pair Hero's Entrance with your jungler rather than solo-committing.

edits.before: - Nami Aqua Prison: matchup-defining — The bubble starts every Nami play — sidestep it and her kit is small numbers. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep W Shield of Durand banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: Aqua Prison (Q) is 12s at rank 1, down to 8s at rank 5 — sidestep it and her kit is small numbers until it's back. Tidal Wave (R) is 120s at rank 1, so a used ult is a long window to force fights.
